title: Proper compactification piece
statement:
For the proper piece $p$ and every strict-perfect $F^\bullet$ on $Y$,

$$
(Rp_*j_!E)\otimes^LF^\bullet
\xrightarrow[\pi_{p,j_!E,F}]{\sim}
Rp_*(j_!E\otimes^LLp^*F^\bullet),
$$

with inverse $\rho_{p,j_!E,F}$.

proof.text: Use the chosen factorization $f=pj$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$, with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p$ proper, of [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. In the ringed pro-etale topoi and derived categories of module sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows], put $A=j_!E$, an object on $\overline X$. The strict-perfect package [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package] on $F^\bullet$ means that it is bounded and has maps $i_r:F^r\to R^{\oplus N_r}$ and $p_r:R^{\oplus N_r}\to F^r$ with $p_ri_r=1$, where $R$ is the coefficient ring sheaf on $Y$. Thus it satisfies the bounded finite-projective hypothesis of [lemma-weil-pbc-projection-formula-totalization]. Apply that lemma with $h=p$ and its object $E$ equal to $A$: its conclusion is $\rho_{p,A,F}\pi_{p,A,F}=1$ and $\pi_{p,A,F}\rho_{p,A,F}=1$. The arrow definition gives domain $Rp_*A\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}F^\bullet$ and codomain $Rp_*(A\otimes_S^{\mathbf L}Lp^*F^\bullet)$, where $S$ is the coefficient ring sheaf on $\overline X$. Substituting $A=j_!E$ gives precisely the displayed morphism and its specified inverse. No boundedness assumption on $E$ and no identification with condensed-module coefficients is used.
